 Detailed observations 

 1. Stripe 
https://stripe.com/  (https://stripe.com/) 

 Before / desktop action At 1440px, the header showed Products, Solutions, Developers, Resources, Pricing, Sign in, and Contact sales. A real mouse hover on Products opened the mega menu. 


 After / keyboard The open menu visibly covered the hero with product, revenue, money management, embedded finance, industry, and other columns. Escape closed it; Tab then focused the Stripe homepage link. 


 Mobile 390px The desktop links collapsed to a logo and Toggle navigation menu. Clicking it opened the full-screen menu and showed the listed sections plus bottom Start now and Contact sales actions. Escape returned to the page. 


 Obstacle / evidence No access obstacle. Screenshots:  stripe-desktop-before.png ,  stripe-desktop-hover.png ,  stripe-mobile-before.png ,  stripe-mobile-menu.png . 


 


 2. Linear 
https://linear.app/  (https://linear.app/)

 After / keyboard The dropdown showed Intake, Plan and monitor, AI and automations, Build, review and ship, Integration directory, Changelog, Mobile, and Security. Escape closed it; Tab focused Resources. 


 Mobile 390px The mobile header showed Linear, Log in, Sign up, and a hamburger. Clicking the hamburger opened a long full-screen menu with System, Product, and Resources groupings, including Intake, Integrations, Pricing, Documentation, About, Customers, Careers, Contact, and Now.

 After / keyboard Tab focused the Store link with href  https://www.raycast.com/store . Escape caused no visible change. No navigation link was activated.
